question: In round 2, after going back to the median-split tree, you tried shrinking the traversal stack to 16 entries with a depth cap of 15. Besides its best time, what render_ms_avg did that 5-frame benchmark print?
answer: render_ms_avg=126.379 ms. That run (PT_BVH_STACK_SIZE 20->16 plus PT_BVH_MAX_DEPTH 16->15, on the median-split tree) was a 5-frame benchmark on the default scene at 512x512/64spp seed 1, and the full printed line was: render_ms_best=119.866 render_ms_avg=126.379 gpu_ms_best=119.359 spp=64 width=512 height=512 samples=16777216 threads_used=8. I know it because the run output is archived as message #125, which I just re-read verbatim to confirm the frame count (--benchmark 5) and the exact numbers. For context, that configuration was a regression (best 119.9 vs ~101.8 for stack 20 / cap 16 in the same round, #129), so I reverted it; the later 59.1ms result came from the near-first child traversal plus kLeafSize=1, both with stack 20 / cap 16.
